# Boot evidence for gcp-n2d-opt1-v1-*, copied from the session on attestamp-snp-vendor, 2026-11-11 (UTC).
# Option 1, application archive appended to the base initrd WITHOUT padding.

$ sudo ./mkappinitrd -base /boot/initrd.img-7.0.0-1017-gcp -app-text 'attestamp app v1' -placement last -out /boot/initrd-attestamp-app.img

placement last
combined  /boot/initrd-attestamp-app.img  50101819 bytes  sha256 bc5662827304f527b6e6988e0e2fab248b4a5c28d27665f7666ba87717ef1153
